page-lede: The released version of the method, and how to cite it.
cite-body-1: The engine, the instructions, the language files and the starter tree are in a public GitHub repository, vidarsko/ai-skill-trees. This site publishes release v0.33.0 of it.
cite-body-2: Each release is archived at Zenodo with its own DOI. Release 0.33.0 is 10.5281/zenodo.23261926. The DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22959546 always points to the newest release.
cite-body-3: If you use the method or the material, please cite the release you used rather than the main branch:
